*End of the [[Hunt for Zsinj]]

The following events took place in '''8 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*The [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] opened its borders and initiated a [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomatic]] visit to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TCPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
*The [[Hunt for Zsinj]] ended.<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
**The [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] were defeated; [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] received the remaining records of the ''[[Chu'unthor]]''; [[Zsinj]] [[Death/Legends|died]] in [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|battle]]; the [[blockade of Dathomir]] is broken.<ref name="TCPL" />
**[[Zsinj's Empire]] fell.<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa/Legends|Wedding of Han Solo and Leia Organa]].<ref name="TCPL" />
*The [[Post–Zsinj campaigns]]: The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Treuten Teradoc|Teradoc]] fought for the remains of Zsinj's Empire.<ref name="Atlas" />
**The [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|shipyards]] of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] were seized by the New Republic at the [[Taking of Kuat]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
**The New Republic liberated [[New Alderaan/Legends|New Alderaan]] from the Galactic Empire, since Zsinj had perished.
**[[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] joined the New Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />
**Collapse of the [[Greater Maldrood]]. Teradoc fled to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="Atlas" />
*[[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Kentor Sarne]] escaped into the [[Kathol sector/Legends|Kathol sector]] following the [[Battle of Kal'Shebbol|liberation]] of [[Kal'Shebbol/Legends|Kal'Shebbol]].
*[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]] returned from the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] to the Empire proper following [[Ysanne Isard]]'s defeat in the [[Bacta War]] and prepared his [[Thrawn campaign|final campaign]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**Thrawn became [[Supreme Commander (Galactic Empire)/Legends|Supreme Commander of the Imperial Forces]].<ref name="Atlas" />
**[[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Voss Parck/Legends|Voss Parck]] became the leader of the [[Empire of the Hand]].<ref name="VotF">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>
**Thrawn created his own [[Thrawn's confederation|confederation]] and took control of the elements of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] not recalled to the Deep Core.<ref name="Atlas" />
